task: Adaptive conditional feature acquisition beyond supplied parity
overall_status: internal proof for structured rank-2 case; general conditional-sample TV learning open problem closed by Liu-Moitra STOC 2025; exact worst-history feature identification is not implied by constant-TV learning

claims.claim: With A_i=A_{i-1}1{X_i=s_i}, X_i fair, and Z_i|A_i distributed as Ber(3/4) if alive and Ber(1/4) if dead, every cut has at most two distinct future rows, hence rank at most 2. A clocked HMM lift uses at most 8T+1 states; emitting transition weights are 1/8 or 3/8, with deterministic termination allowed.
claims.supplied_structure: T, the pair alphabet, clocked prefix-match template, and marker noise 1/4; no secret s or candidate predictive-feature dictionary is supplied.

claims.claim: Independent chosen-prefix full-suffix conditional samples recover s exactly with failure at most delta using m=ceil(2(1-2eta)^(-2)log(2T/delta)) calls per bit. The statistic R=(-1)^X(Z-1/2) has conditional mean plus or minus (1-2eta)/2.
assumptions: Known eta or certified upper bound below 1/2

resources.returned_suffixes: m*T*(T+1)/2 pair symbols = m*T*(T+1) bits; all suffix symbols charged
resources.communication: m*T^2 pair symbols = 2*m*T^2 raw bits, excluding framing
resources.memory: O(T+log m) bits with streamed responses; plus O(T) pair symbols if buffering a suffix
resources.runtime: O(m*T^2) bit operations including all I/O and prefix encoding
resources.precision: No numerical oracle output; exact half-integer arithmetic; T-bit feature output

claims.claim: For two words differing only in s_T, exact one-path TV is (1-2eta)*2^(-(T-1)). Any estimator on N iid passive paths has average last-bit error at least [1-N*(1-2eta)*2^(-(T-1))]/2; success >=2/3 requires N>=2^(T-1)/(3*(1-2eta)). At eta=1/4 this is 2^T/3.
claims.scope: Exact rare-history feature identification, not constant-TV distribution approximation.

claims.claim: Along a successful run, the exact queried history ((s_1,1),...,(s_{k-1},1)) has mass ((1-eta)/2)^(k-1), or (3/8)^(k-1) for eta=1/4. Passive rejection costs the inverse expected resets. Conditional-call count is therefore not an equal-cost passive sample count.

Kakade et al. COLT 2023 Open Problem 1 asks for efficient chosen-prefix conditional-sample learning of any low-rank law. Liu and Moitra STOC 2025 Theorem 1.3 resolves arbitrary-rank distribution learning in TV with poly(S,|Omega|,T,1/epsilon) conditional queries/time and an efficiently samplable output.
claims.scope: Does not imply exact rare-history feature recovery at polynomial T: neighboring words have TV only (1-2eta)*2^(-(T-1)); a generic TV guarantee must take epsilon below half this gap. This is not a lower bound against a specialized algorithm.

claims.claim: At equal response-symbol budget, m calls per level return m*T*(T+1)/2 pair symbols, matched by floor(m*(T+1)/2) passive paths. An oracle-known-s control uses T side-information bits and can score the same conditional validation responses. Passive and conditional validation samples cannot be literally paired because the interfaces return different conditional laws. GF(2) nullspace on X has no information because X is iid uniform independent of s.

novelty_boundary: No novelty claim. Explicit feature-identification witness and passive lower bound for a structured rank-two class. Arbitrary-rank conditional-sample TV learning is covered by Liu-Moitra STOC 2025.
